name: Visual Hull Oracle Kernel
definition: Kernel that makes binary culling decision for each voxel based on whether it intersects the surface S(p) = 0.5. Uses hierarchical mip pyramids over silhouette images to find conservative bounds on S(p) within each voxel.
summary: The Visual Hull Oracle Kernel performs binary voxel culling by component-wise multiplying conservative silhouette bounds across multiple views to determine if voxels intersect the visual hull surface.
